answer: Plant answers that are junk by construction and watch who approves them. Each epoch seeds a few honeypot submissions, machine-verifiably empty like yarrow dressed up to resemble grain, scattered through the grading grove. An honest grader scores them low on merit; any grader who passes one reveals itself as careless or colluding and is slashed. The delta between a grader's verdicts and the known-bad ground truth needs no human judgment, so detection stays cheap, exact, and free of false positives against genuinely honest reviewers.
